FT-034.adaptation: Extended rev 1's converge.rs (bounded fixed-point, 8-pass cap, full history) rather than replacing it: ConvergenceError became an enum with Cycle (found by scanning the completed history for the earliest repeated candidate, proven to loop forever since pages_for is a pure function of its candidate) and Unresolved (no repeat within the bound) variants, still always running the full 8 passes so history length never depends on when a cycle could have been detected early. Kept rev 1's leader-measurement, malformed-input, and Unicode tests passing unmodified.
